introHtml: When you need badge ID holders that can keep up with daily wear, Hanes offers a dependable choice. Their tagless t-shirts and hoodies provide a smooth, itch-free surface for attaching IDs, while the full-zip hoodies make for easy badge access. Whether you're outfitting a safety crew or a marketing team, Hanes badge ID holders combine comfort with practical branding. Choose from youth or adult sizes and explore decoration options like screen printing or embroidery to make your logo stand out.
